scenarioTitle: Fit approved desk and field work into a disrupted claims schedule

sourceCatalog.support: Sections 2695.3, 2695.5, 2695.6 and 2695.9 distinguish record documentation, communications, training, and certain property insurance requirements.
sourceCatalog.limit: This case uses internal planning cutoff windows, does not determine any statutory time or proof trigger, and does not measure legal compliance.

sourceCatalog.sourceTitle: 2026 Guide for Adjusting Property Claims in California After a Major Disaster
sourceCatalog.sourceVersion: January 9, 2026; ordinary and declared-emergency requirements, pages 6–8
sourceCatalog.support: The guide describes distinct licensing, registration, supervision and certification contexts, including arrangements conditional on a Commissioner-declared emergency.
sourceCatalog.limit: Operational surge does not mean a declared emergency. This sample does not verify real credentials or assume an emergency permission.

sourceCatalog.support: CDI publishes information on independent adjuster licensing and distinct emergency registration/certification processes.
sourceCatalog.limit: The role grants in this fixture are approved operational inputs and do not substitute for current legal authority or professional credentials.

sourceCatalog.support: Dispatch limited to a sample approved queue, current roster scopes and calendars, distinct desk/field duties, confirmed field access, exclusive shared support, and protected booking locks.
sourceCatalog.limit: The sample employer rules are not statutory obligations, insurance policy terms, or real authorization records.

INS-OPS-001.ruleName: Review the approved work queue and service zone

INS-OPS-002.ruleName: Confirm field access before reserving an inspection slot

INS-OPS-003.ruleName: Match a current approved duty and zone

INS-OPS-004.ruleName: Stay in offered windows at or before the internal cutoff

INS-OPS-005.ruleName: Fit the staff calendar and exclusive shared support

INS-OPS-006.ruleName: Preserve confirmed bookings; minimize changes to other prior placements

work_scope_review.reviewAction: Have a coordinator confirm that the work item was approved for this scheduling queue.

region_scope_review.reviewAction: Confirm a service zone and its approved roster before proposing a booking.

site_access_review.reviewAction: Confirm access through an authorized human channel; no outreach is sent.

authorization_review.reviewAction: Ask the roster owner to confirm a current assignment scope; do not infer a permission from the surge.

no_slot_before_target.reviewAction: Review offered slots before the company target; route a target exception to the coordinator.

no_staffed_window.reviewAction: Find a different offered window with both authorized staff and field support, where required.

shared_plan_capacity.reviewAction: Review worker and shared support capacity across the proposed plan.

within_approved_capacity.reviewAction: Confirm the proposal before making any system or calendar change.

replacement_capacity_found.reviewAction: Review the proposed replacement beside its earlier slot and coach the handoff.

prior_booking_retained.reviewAction: No change to the previously proposed slot or assigned staff resource.

locked_booking_retained.reviewAction: Keep the already confirmed booking unchanged.
